sources: Facts from the publisher's official character and setting announcements. All text written for Vicefold.

guides.title: How to use Vicefold
guides.body:
# Spoiler-free by default
Tell Vicefold which chapter you're in (Settings › Spoilers). Anything after it stays hidden until you get there. Finishing a mission moves you forward on its own.
# Your map
- Tap the pin button, then tap the map to drop your own pin. Give it a name, a note, an icon and a color.
- Mark places as visited: they count toward your 100%.
- With Pro, import a screenshot of the game's full map and line it up once: your pins then sit on your real map.
# Your 100%
Missions, places, collectibles and challenges each fill a part of the ring. Share it as an image from the Tracker.
> On an iPhone Duo, open it: the list sits on one side of the fold and the details on the other.

guides.title: Your first hours
guides.summary: Good habits that pay off for the whole game.
guides.body:
# Follow the story first
The early missions open up the map, the shops and most activities. Side content is easier once you have a car, a phone and some cash.
# Habits worth having
- Check your phone often: new contacts, jobs and texts unlock activities.
- Keep some money aside: properties and upgrades pay back over time.
- Explore by boat as well as by car: a lot of Leonida is coastline and wetlands.
- Note anything odd on your Vicefold map with a pin: you'll want to come back to it.
> Stuck on a mission? Open it in the Tracker: objectives and tips are there, spoiler-free.

guides.title: The regions of Leonida
guides.summary: Six regions, from the city to the national park.
guides.body:
# Vice City
The big city on the east coast, with Vice Beach on its barrier island.
# Leonida Keys
Islands linked by long bridges, with boats everywhere.
# Grassrivers
Wetlands and airboats in the south: watch the water.
# Port Gellhorn
A faded beach town on the gulf coast, in the north-west.
# Ambrosia
Farmland and sugar country around Lake Leonida.
# Mount Kalaga
Forests, trails and rivers in the national park up north.

characters.name: Jason Duval
characters.bio: Grew up around grifters and crooks, then tried the army. Now he works for a drug runner down in the Keys and wants something steadier — until he meets Lucia.

characters.name: Lucia Caminos
characters.bio: Fresh out of the Leonida Penitentiary and determined not to go back. Fiercely loyal to her family and to Jason, and the one who often has the plan.

characters.name: Cal Hampton
characters.bio: Jason's buddy and fellow worker for Brian. Spends his free time reading about conspiracies and listening in on the Coast Guard radio.

characters.name: Boobie Ike
characters.bio: A Vice City fixture who turned street money into real estate, a strip club and a recording studio. Business first, always.

characters.name: Dre'Quan Priest
characters.bio: A hustler who swapped the street for the music business and runs a label with Boobie. Always looking for the next big act.

characters.name: Real Dimez
characters.bio: Bae-Luxe and Roxy, best friends since school, went viral and now want to turn the buzz into a real career.

characters.name: Raul Bautista
characters.bio: A seasoned, confident robber who is always looking for new talent for bigger and riskier jobs.

characters.name: Brian Heder
characters.bio: An old-school smuggler who has run boats through the Keys for decades and lets Jason live in one of his properties — at a price.
